title: Client sweep excuses a non-2xx answer whenever Jellyfin gives the same status
notes: test/differential/run/clients.go sweep(): a listed request answered 400/404 by jellyscale passes if Jellyfin, asked the same, gives the same status. The criterion says each listed request must answer 2xx. A listed request built with a wrong fixture (id, body) that both servers reject therefore never fails. A real route that jellyscale breaks into a 404 for a client body Jellyfin also rejects stays Closed at the pivot: Tied to a Jellyfin route, a Jellyfin app, jellyfin-web, Quick Connect or Jellyfin's tooling, all removed at the cutover (D-107, D-109, rule 3).
